tldr: 台積電獨撐大局，加權指數守住 47,000，其餘權值股熄火、外資調節。
AI 伺服器需求與工研院 7 兆元產值預估鞏固台灣供應鏈，金管會則聚焦防詐與資安韌性。
央行利率連凍守 2% 但操作偏緊、通膨略過警戒線；CARF 與 CRS 2.0 擴大加密資產稅務申報。
華爾街改寫紀錄，那斯達克因 AI 交易收盤創高；油價因沙國調降對亞洲售價而下跌。
美債殖利率攀多年高點，金價回落逼近 4,100 美元；亞股走揚、日經逼近三個月高點。

items.title_zh: 台積電獨撐大局 權值股熄火 加權指數守住 47,000
items.title_en: TSMC Single-Handedly Holds the TAIEX Above 47,000
items.summary_zh: 近期盤勢權值股普遍熄火，加權指數一度下跌約 220 點，所幸台積電獨強，撐住 47,000 點關卡。盤面顯示台股對單一權值股依賴度升高，若 AI 族群休息，大盤恐缺乏支撐，後續須留意電子權值股輪動與外資動向。
items.summary_en: The TAIEX slipped around 220 points in a recent session as most heavyweight stocks lost momentum, yet TSMC's strength alone kept the benchmark above the 47,000 mark. The split performance highlights how reliant Taiwan's index has become on its largest chipmaker, leaving the broader market exposed if AI-related leaders pause.

items.title_zh: 外資調節 被動元件逆勢強攻
items.title_en: Foreign Investors Sell as Passive Components Buck the Trend
items.summary_zh: 外資近期於全市場大舉調節，賣超數百億元，加權指數震盪回檔並一度逼近 47,000 關卡；惟被動元件類股逆勢強攻，資金出現由高檔權值轉進落後補漲族群的跡象，顯示盤面進入類股輪動階段，投資人宜留意資金流向變化。
items.summary_en: Overseas funds sold heavily across the market in a recent session, pressuring the index back toward the 47,000 level, while passive-component makers rallied against the broader pullback. The rotation suggests investors are trimming crowded large-caps and selectively hunting laggards for catch-up gains.

items.title_zh: 工研院：2026 台灣半導體產值上看 7 兆元
items.title_en: ITRI Sees Taiwan Chip Output Topping NT$7 Trillion in 2026
items.summary_zh: 工研院預估，2026 年台灣半導體產值可突破 7 兆元、約 7.13 兆元，年增約一成，其中 IC 製造受惠 3 奈米滿載與 2 奈米放量，動能最強。顯示 AI 需求持續帶動先進製程，鞏固台灣在全球晶片供應鏈的關鍵地位，相關供應鏈營運可望同步受惠。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute projects the island's semiconductor output value will exceed NT$7 trillion (about NT$7.13tn) in 2026, up roughly 10% year-on-year, led by IC manufacturing as 3nm runs at full capacity and 2nm ramps. The outlook shows AI-driven demand keeping Taiwan central to global chip supply.

items.title_zh: AI 伺服器熱潮 台廠營收續創高
items.title_en: AI-Server Boom Lifts Taiwan Hardware Makers to Record Revenue
items.summary_zh: AI 伺服器需求強勁，帶動台灣主要 IT 廠營收連月成長，伺服器組裝、載板、高階 PCB、散熱與電源供應等供應鏈同步受惠。顯示台灣供應鏈橫跨設計、製造、封測與零組件，持續扮演全球 AI 硬體建置樞紐，惟須留意終端需求與庫存變化對後續動能的影響。
items.summary_en: Surging AI-server demand has driven major Taiwan IT makers to months of consecutive revenue growth, with assemblers plus advanced-PCB, substrate, cooling and power-supply suppliers all benefiting. The broad-based strength shows Taiwan's chain—spanning design, fabrication, packaging and components—remains the hub of the AI hardware build-out.

items.title_zh: 金管會：安全與發展並進 防詐、資安韌性列重點
items.title_en: FSC Keeps "Safety and Development in Parallel," Puts Anti-Fraud and Cyber-Resilience First
items.summary_zh: 金管會施政延續「安全與發展並進」，強化金融機構資本韌性與風險管理，並將防詐列為重點工作。資安方面新增監理要求，包括明定金融資安長權責、零信任架構由鼓勵改為必備，以及建立軟體供應鏈安全（SBOM）機制，推升金融業合規與資安投入。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission says its agenda continues to balance stability with growth—strengthening banks' capital resilience and risk management while elevating fraud prevention. New cyber rules define responsibilities for financial CISOs, make zero-trust architecture mandatory rather than encouraged, and require software-supply-chain security (SBOM) mechanisms.

items.title_zh: 金融三業獲利居高 金管會推金融科技創新
items.title_en: Record Sector Profits Set Backdrop as FSC Advances Fintech Reform
items.summary_zh: 金融三業稅前獲利居歷史高檔，為監理單位推動金融科技創新提供空間。金管會規劃修訂金融科技發展與創新實驗條例、發展數位保險公司，並設「金融行動創新法規調適平台」，由銀行、保險、證券期貨與科技創新工作小組建立產官學溝通管道，兼顧創新與穩定。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's three major financial sectors posted among their highest-ever pre-tax earnings, giving regulators room to push fintech priorities: amending the fintech innovation-and-experimentation act, developing digital insurers, and a new regulatory-adaptation platform linking banking, insurance, securities and tech working groups to modernise supervision while safeguarding stability.

items.title_zh: 台灣億級富豪逾 12.4 萬人 掌握 46.1 兆元財富
items.title_en: Taiwan's Ultra-Rich to Top 124,000, Commanding NT$46 Trillion
items.summary_zh: 據金融業者與會計師事務所調查，2026 年台灣資產逾 1 億元的高資產客戶將成長至逾 12.4 萬人，合計掌握約 46.1 兆元財富，且人數以年均約一成成長，2029 年上看 15.5 萬人。龐大高資產族群帶動私人銀行、信託與跨境配置需求，成為財管業兵家必爭之地。
items.summary_en: A bank-and-accountancy study cited in local media projects Taiwan will have more than 124,000 individuals with assets over NT$100 million in 2026, together holding some NT$46.1 trillion, with the high-net-worth population growing about 10% a year toward 155,000 by 2029. The expanding pool is reshaping demand for private banking, trusts and cross-border allocation.

items.title_zh: 高資產族群重傳承 跨境與月配息為配置核心
items.title_en: Succession Planning and Offshore Assets Dominate HNW Portfolios
items.summary_zh: 財富調查顯示，台灣高資產客戶將跨境配置視為支撐家族與企業傳承的基礎，約 74% 已持有境外資產，約 85% 已啟動或準備傳承規劃。核心配置以股票型基金為主，偏好台股與科技類股；債券則青睞新興市場債與月配息級別，顯示財管需求從單純投資轉向資產結構與世代傳承。
items.summary_en: Wealth reports show Taiwan's high-net-worth clients increasingly treat cross-border allocation as core to family and business continuity, with about 74% already holding offshore assets and roughly 85% engaged in or preparing succession plans. Equity funds—especially Taiwan and tech names—anchor portfolios, while bond demand favours emerging-market and monthly-dividend share classes.

items.title_zh: CARF、CRS 2.0 上路 加密資產申報全面擴大
items.title_en: Crypto Reporting Widens as CARF and CRS 2.0 Take Hold
items.summary_zh: OECD《加密資產申報框架》（CARF）正式啟動、《共同申報準則》改版（CRS 2.0）同步施行，全球稅務資訊交換已涵蓋加密資產，2026 年起再把電子貨幣與央行數位貨幣帳戶納入，參與地區逾 110 個。擴大範圍意在防堵透過數位資產跨境逃稅，也提高台灣持有人的申報與合規負擔。
items.summary_en: With the OECD's Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF) live and the revised Common Reporting Standard (CRS 2.0) in force, global tax-information exchange now covers crypto assets and, from 2026, e-money and central-bank-digital-currency accounts, across 110-plus jurisdictions. The expansion tightens the net on cross-border tax avoidance via digital assets and raises compliance demands on Taiwan holders.

items.title_zh: 財政部研議加密貨幣課稅 最低稅負制維持從嚴
items.title_en: Finance Ministry Weighs Crypto Tax Rules; AMT Scope Stays Broad
items.summary_zh: 財政部正研議加密貨幣交易課稅規定，涉及入出金時點、平台所在地與資產性質認定，後續解釋方向將直接影響個人與企業稅務規劃。同時最低稅負制仍全額計入私募證券投資信託基金受益憑證交易所得、非現金列舉捐贈，以及 2021 年以後未上市櫃證券交易所得等項目，高資產族群申報須留意。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of Finance is studying how to tax crypto transactions—weighing deposit/withdrawal timing, platform location and asset classification—guidance that will directly shape individual and corporate planning. Meanwhile the alternative minimum tax (AMT) continues to fully capture items such as private securities-fund gains, non-cash itemised donations and post-2021 unlisted-share transactions.

items.title_zh: 央行利率連凍守 2% 貨幣操作轉趨偏緊
items.title_en: Central Bank Holds Rate at 2% but Leans Toward Tightening
items.summary_zh: 台灣央行政策利率已連續約十季按兵不動、維持 2%，惟總裁楊金龍釋出貨幣操作朝緊縮方向的訊號。在 AI 帶動成長強勁、市場資金充沛下，央行對過熱保持警覺，顯示後續動作偏向收緊市場流動性，而非降息，企業與房市資金成本短期難鬆。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank has kept its benchmark policy rate at 2% for roughly ten straight quarters, yet Governor Yang Chin-long signals monetary operations are tilting toward tightening. Robust AI-driven growth and ample liquidity leave policymakers wary of overheating, suggesting the next move is more likely a squeeze on liquidity than a cut.

items.title_zh: 通膨略超 2% 警戒區 楊金龍：仍有觀察時間
items.title_en: Inflation Nudges Above the 2% Alert Line
items.summary_zh: 央行最新消費者物價（CPI）預測略高於 2% 警戒門檻，總裁楊金龍表示仍有時間觀察再決定，並維持偏緊基調。通膨微升使物價穩定重回焦點，即便經濟維持強勁成長，也強化市場對短期內不會降息的預期，後續須緊盯物價與國際情勢變化。
items.summary_en: The central bank's latest CPI forecast has edged above its 2% warning threshold, prompting Governor Yang to say there is still time to observe before acting while keeping a tightening bias. The uptick keeps price stability in focus even as growth stays strong, reinforcing expectations that rate cuts remain off the table near term.

items.title_zh: 市場對聯準會 2026 降息次數看法分歧
items.title_en: Market Split on How Many Fed Cuts 2026 Will Bring
items.summary_zh: 台灣財經媒體報導，市場對聯準會 2026 年政策路徑看法分歧：部分機構認為全年不降息，因美國就業與成長再加速、核心通膨仍高；CME FedWatch 利率期貨則押注一碼、兩碼甚至三碼降息機率不一。政策不確定性升高，使全球股市與台灣出口類股對每一次美國數據都高度敏感。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese financial media report sharply divided views on the Fed's 2026 path: some houses see no cuts at all as US jobs and growth reaccelerate and core inflation runs above 3%, while CME FedWatch pricing still spreads across one, two or even three cuts. The uncertainty leaves global equities and Taiwan exporters sensitive to every US data release.

items.title_zh: 美債 Q4 淨流入近 800 億 法人政策焦點轉向
items.title_en: Foreign Money Floods US Bonds in Q4 as Focus Shifts to Policy
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體報導，第四季以來美債相關商品淨流入近新台幣 800 億元，法人將焦點轉向聯準會利率節奏，趕在可能降息前鎖利布局。此舉顯示台灣資金正為「較高利率維持更久」的環境定位，同時提前因應景氣循環後段可能出現的轉折，債市鎖利需求升溫。
items.summary_en: Local reports note nearly NT$80bn of net inflows into US bond products early in Q4, as institutional investors pivot their focus toward the Fed's rate trajectory and lock in yields before any easing. The move signals Taiwanese capital is positioning for a higher-for-longer rate world while hedging against a later turn in the cycle.

items.title_zh: 那斯達克收盤創高 AI 交易續撐華爾街（2026-10-05）
items.title_en: Nasdaq Closes at a Record as the AI Trade Powers Wall Street (2026-10-05)
items.summary_zh: 美股週一走高，那斯達克指數收在約 27,477 點、漲 1.05% 創收盤新高，盤中一度觸及約 27,544 點；標普 500 漲約 0.66% 至約 7,774 點，道瓊漲 0.18% 至約 51,268 點。AI 相關個股領漲，輝達、特斯拉各漲約 2%，Meta、微軟同步走高，惟 ISM 數據公布後美債殖利率走升。
items.summary_en: US stocks climbed Monday, with the Nasdaq Composite posting a record close around 27,477 (+1.05%) after an intraday high near 27,544. The S&P 500 rose about 0.66% to roughly 7,774 and the Dow added 0.18% to about 51,268. AI-linked names led, with Nvidia and Tesla up around 2% and Meta and Microsoft higher, even as Treasury yields firmed after ISM data.

items.title_zh: 沙國調降對亞洲售價 國際油價下跌（2026-10-05）
items.title_en: Oil Falls as Saudi Arabia Cuts Asia Prices (2026-10-05)
items.summary_zh: 國際油價週一走跌，沙烏地阿拉伯將指標原油阿拉伯輕原油對亞洲買家的官方售價調降約每桶 5 美元、低於區域基準，為 2020 年以來最大降幅。布蘭特原油收跌約 1.9%、逼近每桶 100 美元，西德州中級原油跌約 1.8% 至約 89 美元，反映市場對需求轉弱與供給充裕的預期。
items.summary_en: Crude slid Monday after Saudi Arabia lowered the official selling price of its benchmark Arab Light grade to Asian buyers by about $5 versus the regional benchmark—the deepest cut since 2020. Brent settled down roughly 1.9% near $100 a barrel and WTI fell about 1.8% to around $89, signalling softer demand expectations and ample supply heading into the quarter.

items.title_zh: 亞股走揚 日經逼近三個月高點（2026-10-05）
items.title_en: Asian Stocks Rally, Nikkei Nears Three-Month High (2026-10-05)
items.summary_zh: 亞洲股市走高，升息預期降溫帶動 AI 與晶片族群領漲。日本日經 225 指數上漲約 2.1%、逼近約 69,700 點，接近三個月高點；香港恆生指數則下跌約 0.5% 至約 23,850 點。區域表現分歧，凸顯 AI 硬體循環正主導資金流向，即便各地對利率路徑看法不一，科技權值仍是盤面主軸。
items.summary_en: Asian equities advanced as bets on further rate hikes eased, led by AI and chip names. Japan's Nikkei 225 climbed about 2.1% toward roughly 69,700, near a three-month high, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng slipped about 0.5% to around 23,850. The divergence underscores how the AI-hardware cycle is steering regional flows even amid mixed rate expectations.

items.title_zh: 美債殖利率走升 金價回落逼近 4,100 美元（2026-10-05）
items.title_en: Gold Slips Toward $4,100 as Treasury Yields Climb (2026-10-05)
items.summary_zh: 黃金價格承壓、逼近每盎司 4,100 美元關卡，美債殖利率攀至多年高點、加上美元轉強，削弱不孳息資產的吸引力，交易人在前波強勢上漲後獲利了結。此番回落反映「較高利率維持更久」的敘事重新主導市場，即便金價在 2026 年稍早曾創歷史新高，短線仍面臨修正壓力。
items.summary_en: Gold came under pressure near the $4,100-an-ounce level as rising US Treasury yields—hovering near multi-year highs—and a firmer dollar sapped demand for the non-yielding metal, with traders also booking profits after a strong run. The pullback reflects a "higher-for-longer" rate narrative reasserting itself even after gold's record run earlier in 2026.
